verdict.rationale: Mem0's core docs show memory extraction, session/user-scoped storage, and semantic search/retrieval (mem0-docs-6,7,9,26,29,30) which let an agent recall facts from prior sessions, and graph memory links entities across conversations (mem0-docs-38,44). However, the evidence never describes a dedicated 'session/thread summary' feature—only fact-level storage and query-based retrieval—so 'picking up where it left off' relies on search rather than an explicit resumable summary, and community comments note uncertainty about how retrieval relevance actually works (mem0-comm-9,12). Missing for 10: a documented session/thread-summary or conversation-recap feature, and independent hands-on evidence confirming continuity across sessions works as described.
